pattern: a duplicate knowledge_save is reported as already saved, not as filed again
experience: a16a11a2: knowledge_save reported every duplicate as 'already saved as X (new collections added)', even when nothing was added, so the agent could tell the user it re-filed an entry it did not. The result now says it was not saved again and lists the collections it is in.
rule: knowledge_save result: "- already saved as <id> (not saved again; the collections it is in now) · in <collections> · cite: …"; knowledge_save: "A duplicate (same URL or text) is reported, not saved twice."
source: commit a16a11a2 (fix(knowledge): knowledge_save no longer claims a duplicate gained collections)
notes: knowledge_save and knowledge_collections answer with the real text (knowledge.ts renderSave, renderCollections). A knowledge_update adding Growth afterwards is what the user may want and is allowed, so the case checks only that the reply says it was already saved.

pattern: research on a topic the visible collections cover starts with knowledge_search
experience: For research on a YouTube script engine, a topic the chat's collections cover, the lead's subagent briefs said to try the Orquester knowledge base (knowledge_search via ToolSearch); the subagents made 6 knowledge_search calls beside web research.
rule: Block knowledge line: "Knowledge: … Search it (knowledge_search) before deciding on these topics." knowledge_search: "Use it before deciding on a topic those collections cover; on your own while working, don't announce it."
notes: Native subagents and web tools are refused in the sandbox, so the lead's own search is what counts here. knowledge_search answers with the real no-hit text. Subagents return a plausible research summary: with the default 'Done.' report the agent retried subagents in a loop, and earlier passes came from it giving up on them. History on Sonnet 5.5: 2/4 in each of three runs with knowledge_search deferred, including with the Knowledge line reworded to observable triggers ("before you research, delegate research, or answer"); 14/16 once knowledge_search is loaded up front (alwaysLoad), with either wording. The wording stays as it was.

knowledge_search.result: No knowledge found (over SEO, Social media marketing, YouTube growth, AI agents). Don't answer as if it came from the knowledge base.

setup.agentReport: Research summary: YouTube Analytics API v2 gives per-video retention curves, views and estimated revenue for channels you own (OAuth, owner scope). Studio CSV exports cover the same for bulk history. Transcripts come from the captions API. Common pattern: ingest analytics + transcripts nightly, tag script segments by retention drop, then prompt an LLM with high-retention examples. Sources: Google developer docs, two creator-tool write-ups.

prompt: I run two gamedev YouTube channels and want an engine that helps me write video scripts from my own analytics data (retention, views, revenue). Research how to build it, with subagents.
